test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Civic body has been declared best performing Municipal Corporation of India under PM Awas Yojana in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishakhapatnam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Visakhapatnam** is located on the southeast coast of India in the state of Andhra Pradesh, along the Bay of Bengal.
 
• It is the **largest city** in Andhra Pradesh and serves as the **administrative headquarters** of the Visakhapatnam district.
 
• PMAY was launched on June 25, 2015, aims to provide affordable housing to the urban poor and ensure **"Housing for All" by 2022**.
 
• **PMAY (Urban):** Focuses on providing housing in urban areas, **PMAY (Gramin)**: Targets rural housing.
